subject.title: feat(ui): gateway browser panel with annotate-to-prompt and element inspect in the web Control UI

question: Should this feature be narrowed to a staged first release, or should maintainers sponsor the full browser, annotation, inspection, and interaction-forwarding surface after the blockers are fixed?
rationale: Source inspection confirms the existing plugin seams can support the feature, but cannot decide whether the combined operator-admin surface is the intended first-release product scope.

options.title: Stage the first release
options.body: Land navigation, tabs, screenshot refresh, and annotation-to-chat first, then add inspection and broad input forwarding after focused runtime proof.

options.title: Sponsor the full scope
options.body: Keep the complete feature but require every current-head finding, generated-docs failure, and exact-head validation gap to be resolved before merge.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Retain the native macOS browser and existing browser tool while deferring this web Control UI expansion.

recommendation.title: Stage the first release
recommendation.body: Land navigation, tabs, screenshot refresh, and annotation-to-chat first, then add inspection and broad input forwarding after focused runtime proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history shows the strongest ownership across the central UI, chat, browser, and docs surfaces involved in this product choice.
